question: Does the repaired bounded species-by-route-night residual dependence persist when wetter and drier surveys were conducted by the same observer at the same ten physical SiteIDs?
population: Start from the 2,835 ERA5-eligible strictly-prior-history pairs. Strictly-prior-history eligibility already requires identical wet/dry physical SiteIDs at all ten stops. Further require nonmissing ObserverTrackingID and identical observer in the two focal runs.
prediction: Use the same route-cross-fitted 72-h-rainfall common-environment model and prior-history q construction as the full repaired diagnostic; do not refit the endpoint or tune the model to the same-observer subset.
endpoints: bounded residual-dependence coefficient across all fixed-support species x route-night clusters
bounded coefficient among species acoustically silent across the entire drier route

null.generator: Independent Bernoulli draws from the fixed q matrices.
null.support_rule: Observed bounded coefficient exceeds null upper 95% quantile and plus-one P < 0.05.

interpretation.positive: Observer turnover is not required for the residual route-night dependence.
interpretation.boundary: Same-observer sensitivity does not remove within-observer perceptual errors, unmeasured environmental common causes, or identify a biological mechanism.

provenance: No subset rule, metric, q model, seed, tail or support criterion may change after readback.
